Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Hematuria is present. Low urine specific gravity and acidic pH may reflect hydration status or infection. No casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
